plan: lane r127b-1118 controls for the three certificates of s(127) of issues 1015, 1017 and 1020 (mode 'pair': form J and form C) and the house certificate T-305 (mode 'house': form C alone)
written_before: any program of this lane read a certificate; frozen and pushed with the checker

definitions.contact: a margin or clearance of exactly 0
definitions.W: the least right-or-top clearance of the original
definitions.X: the packing's extent, the larger of its width and height
definitions.lambda*: the first contact of a uniform contraction of the centres, the largest pair contact factor H / max_w |d . w|
definitions.rule: every stated outcome is a rule over the certificate's exact facts by method A (rows, side, margins, clearances, contact factors), evaluated exactly by rb127_controls.py and compared with what both methods decide on the changed packing; a decision in which the methods disagree fails its control

controls.change: form C: the last square deleted from the original bytes, the count as stated
controls.outcome: the reader refuses: the count stated exceeds the squares listed

controls.change: form J: the last square deleted from the original bytes
controls.outcome: the reader refuses: the count stated exceeds the squares listed

controls.change: form C: the side written as 2p/2q
controls.outcome: read; the same value and the same corners; only the side flagged as not in lowest terms

controls.change: form J: the side written as 2p/2q
controls.outcome: read; the same value and the same rows; the side flagged as not in lowest terms

controls.change: form C: the ids of squares 1 and 2 exchanged
controls.outcome: the reader refuses: ids out of order

controls.change: form J: rows 1 and 2 exchanged
controls.outcome: read; the twin relation with the original form C fails at exactly squares 1 and 2

controls.change: form C: the side as a 40-place decimal, quoted
controls.outcome: the reader refuses: not a scalar p or p/q

controls.change: form C: the side as a 40-place decimal, unquoted
controls.outcome: the reader refuses: a YAML float

controls.change: form J: the side as a 40-place decimal string
controls.outcome: the reader refuses: not a scalar p or p/q

controls.change: form C: a leading plus sign on square 1's first coordinate
controls.outcome: the reader refuses, naming square 1

controls.change: form J: a leading plus sign on square 1's first coordinate
controls.outcome: the reader refuses, naming square 1

controls.change: form C: square 1's first coordinate replaced by a plain YAML integer
controls.outcome: the reader refuses: a corner scalar that is not a string

controls.change: form J: square 1's first coordinate replaced by a JSON number
controls.outcome: the reader refuses: not a scalar string

controls.change: square n given square 1's row
controls.outcome: refused; the pairs holding square n decided again: (1, n) at margin exactly -1 with B's overlap area exactly 1, the only overlap; each (k, n) at exactly the original margin of (1, k)

controls.change: square 1 translated by (S, 0)
controls.outcome: refused; square 1's clearances exactly (L + S, B, R - S, T), its area inside the box 0 by B, and no pair holding it overlapping

controls.change: form C: square 1's first corner moved by 1e-40 in x
controls.outcome: refused: square 1 is not a unit square by B, nor its pose from the corners by A; the twin relation fails at square 1 only

controls.change: form C: every square listed in reverse
controls.outcome: form C decided alone is accepted with every listing clockwise; every margin identical; the twin relation holds

controls.change: every row transposed, (x, y, c, s) -> (y, x, s, c)
controls.outcome: accepted; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (B, L, T, R)

controls.change: a quarter turn about the box centre, (x, y, c, s) -> (S - y, x, -s, c)
controls.outcome: accepted; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (T, L, B, R)

controls.change: mirrored, (x, y, c, s) -> (S - x, y, -c, s)
controls.outcome: accepted; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (R, B, L, T)

controls.change: the side lowered by 1e-40
controls.outcome: the side rule: left and bottom clearances unchanged, right and top lowered by exactly delta; accepted exactly when delta <= W; touching and crossing exactly the squares the new clearances give

controls.change: the side lowered by 1/q, q the side's denominator as written
controls.outcome: the side rule with delta = 1/q

controls.change: the side lowered by W
controls.outcome: the side rule: accepted, with contacts at exactly the squares that attain W

controls.change: the side lowered by W + 1e-40
controls.outcome: the side rule: refused, those squares crossing

controls.change: the side set to the claim (the issue's 12-place print; for the house, its side's 12-place ceiling)
controls.outcome: the side rule with delta = S - claim

controls.change: the side set to the claim less 1e-12
controls.outcome: the side rule with delta = S - claim + 1e-12

controls.change: every square translated by minus the least left and bottom clearances, and the side set to X
controls.outcome: accepted; every margin identical; the left and bottom walls touched by exactly the squares at the least clearances, and the wall of each larger extent by exactly the squares that reach it

controls.change: the same with the side X - 1e-40
controls.outcome: refused; exactly the squares at the wall of the larger extent cross

controls.change: every centre scaled by lambda*, moved into the corner of the smallest box that holds it, the side that box's
controls.outcome: accepted; every margin exactly lambda* M - H from the original numbers; the touching pairs exactly the pairs whose factor is lambda*; the side the contraction measurement's shrunk side

controls.change: the same with lambda*(1 - 1e-40)
controls.outcome: refused; every margin exactly lambda M - H; the overlapping pairs exactly those whose factor exceeds lambda; no wall crossed

controls.change: K1c's packing in a box 1e-40 smaller
controls.outcome: refused at the right or top wall, and at neither the left nor the bottom

controls.change: none: every margin recomputed from the form C corners by projecting the eight corners on the four edge normals, and every clearance from the corners' extremes
controls.outcome: equal to method A's from the poses at every pair and every square

controls.change: each direction (c, s) read as (c, -s), against the original form C
controls.outcome: the twin relation fails at exactly the squares that are not upright

controls.change: every square moved to its nearest wall, and 1e-40 past it (square-level)
controls.outcome: A's clearance exactly 0 and -1e-40; B touching and crossing that wall; B's area inside exactly 1 and below 1

controls.change: every pair closed along its line of centres to contact, and 1e-40 past it (pair-level)
controls.outcome: A's margin exactly 0 and -1e-40; the corner projections exactly 0 at contact; B touching and overlapping, its two clippings agreeing

priors: each certificate is accepted by both methods in both forms, the twin relation holding at every square
each issue's printed side is the 12-place ceiling of its file's side, and #1017's exact side is its files'
the three sides lie about 9.6e-4 below T-305's
T-305's own contraction margin is far below 9.6e-4, so each of the three passes option D's test against T-305
the #1015 to #1017 and #1017 to #1020 steps are decided by the exact comparison and are not predicted here
